concepts.headline: What I Ordered
concepts.layout: Vertical split screen in warm sand beige and soft coconut cream, with deep teal headings and accents. LEFT half (lighter tone): the heading "What I Ordered" at the top in big bold color type; below it a hand-drawn curved arrow pointing down at the product, which stands on the left half with a small swirl of its cream on the surface beside it; under the product the line "Coconut Breeze body cream" in bold caps; at the very bottom, small, the line "30-day money-back guarantee". RIGHT half (slightly deeper tone): the heading "What I Got" at the top; under it four checklist rows, each a solid green circle with a white check mark followed by short bold all-caps text, in this order: "Only 8 ingredients", "Organic virgin coconut oil", "Scented with coconut oil extract", "Made in the USA"; the lower right half is a smiling woman in her early 30s, natural makeup, hair pulled back, wrapped in a plain white bath towel, photographed from the chest up in soft studio light, looking happy, cropped by the bottom edge.

concepts.headline: Problem
concepts.layout: Vertical split screen. LEFT half is a light off-white panel: the heading "Problem" in big bold black caps at the top; below it three rows, each a pale tinted circle holding a simple thin-line icon (a long crumpled ingredient label, a tangle of chemistry flasks, a perfume spray bottle) followed by short bold text, in this order: "Labels you can't pronounce", "20+ ingredients in one bottle", "Mystery "fragrance" on the label". RIGHT half is a solid strong color panel (deep teal): the heading "Solution" in big bold white caps at the top; below it a dark charcoal rounded card holding four rows, each a solid green circle with a white check mark followed by white text, in this order: "Only 8 ingredients", "Organic virgin coconut oil", "Scented with coconut oil extract", "30-day money-back guarantee"; at the bottom of the right half, an open palm holds the product up, label facing the camera.

concepts.headline: A tropical daily routine
lines: Eight ingredients. Scented with coconut oil extract. Coconut Breeze body cream.
concepts.layout: Three stacked bands. TOP 40%: a smiling woman in her early 30s, natural makeup, hair pulled back, wrapped in a plain white bath towel, photographed from the chest up in soft studio light, leaning her forearms on the top edge of the black band below as if peeking over a ledge, against a soft warm sand beige and soft coconut cream, background with a faint repeating pattern of small line-drawn coconuts, leaves and water droplets. MIDDLE band: a black strip styled exactly like an Instagram post footer: outline heart, comment and send icons at left and a bookmark icon at right on one row, then the handle "@realskincare_com" in bold white, then the caption "Eight ingredients. Scented with coconut oil extract. Coconut Breeze body cream." in regular white. BOTTOM 45%: a solid deep teal panel with the same faint pattern: the product sits on the left with a swirl of its cream beside it; on the right the headline in huge bold white all caps, then two small white lines "Only 8 ingredients" and "30-day money-back guarantee", then a white rounded pill button with dark text "Shop Now →".
